decisions.reason: As a complementary insole that supports the core footwear system, it remains worth retaining because prior launch investment and product-range coherence still outweigh any limited public visibility.

The supportive insole is still a secondary accessory, but management is inclined to continue because it fits the broader footwear offering and another year of commitment makes withdrawal less attractive.
The ergonomic safety shoe series sits in a central product category and has visible multi-model commitment, so management is very likely to persist with it.

These firefighter and rescue boots are a specialized yet core protective-footwear line, and the firm can still justify staying the course on the basis of niche ramp-up and the investment already made.
Because the moulded insole was presented as a flagship and tied to the firm's stated direction, public and strategic commitment make withdrawal highly unlikely.
